_read: Chosen tracks. A track is a file at assets/music/<mood>/ and a row here; delete both to remove it. file starts with the mood's folder: temperate, arid, ice, lava, swamp, ocean, airless, deep-space or hollow. Every track is credited whatever its licence: title, author, source and licence, and for CC-BY, attribution holds the credit word for word. Copy the same line into CREDITS.md at the repo root.
